text:
Ana V: Ferry F1 showing 'service suspended' due to 50+ mph gusts. Just got the alert. :wind_face: https://status.ferry.example.com
Tom H: Oh yikes. I was mid-shower when I saw that. Guess it's BART day.
Priya R: If anyone needs a ride from SoMa, I have two seats. Leaving at 8:05.
Carlos M: @Priya R I can take one, thanks. Will bring spare granola bars for the team.
TransitBot: Advisory: Bay Bridge slow lanes closed for debris removal. Expect 20-35 min delays. Consider alternate routes.
Ana V: Office shuttle will be delayed ~15 mins per OfficeBot update? Anyone else seeing that?
OfficeBot: Shuttle update: 8:00 and 8:30 runs delayed ~15 minutes due to bridge conditions.
Tom H: Poll: in or remote for standup? Reply "in" or "remote".
Priya R: in (but might be late)
Carlos M: remote (bridge looks ugly)
Tom H: remote too, saving my bike from becoming a sail. :joy:
Ana V: Meme: "Weather app: light breeze. Reality: tornado audition" (posted GIF)
OfficeBot: Kitchen note: oats low. If you're headed to the store, please grab a canister. Venmo accepted.
Tom H: Thanks everyone. Update if the ferry resumes or bridge reopens. Stay safe. :thumbsup:
